headline: Terpel to Invest $17 Million in Industrial Solar and Battery Project in Colombia
summary: Angelini Group subsidiary Terpel will invest $17 million to build an industrial self-generation solar power project equipped with battery storage in Colombia. It will represent the country's largest industrial solar battery installation.
why: Organización Terpel is a leading fuel and energy distribution company operating in Colombia and Latin America.

impacts.name: Organización Terpel S.A.
impacts.why: Terpel announced a $17 million solar battery investment in Colombia.
